name: California Licensed Contractors — CSLB Database 2026 — 232,617 Records (CSV)
summary: 232,617 active licensed contractors in California — sourced directly from the CSLB Master License Database. The largest state contractor database in the US. Includes all license classes: A (General Engineering), B (General Building), and 30+ C-specialty trades. $79 one-time vs. $0.10–$2.00/record from commercial brokers.
audience: Building material distributors, construction SaaS vendors (Procore, Buildertrend, CoConstruct SDRs), subcontractor insurance brokers, bonding companies, construction equipment rental companies, safety training providers, lien management software vendors, specialty trade CE providers.
source: California Contractors State License Board (CSLB) Master License Database — cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/DataPortal/ — public bulk download, no auth required
